map.INR（国际标准化比值）= (受试者 PT / 正常对照 PT) ^ ISI: INR (International Normalized Ratio) = (Subject PT / Normal Control PT) ^ ISI
map.INR（国际标准化比值）= (受试者 PT ÷ 正常对照 PT) 的 ISI 次: INR = (Subject PT ÷ Normal Control PT) to the power ISI; PT ratio = Subject PT ÷ Normal Control PT; ISI is the reagent's international sensitivity index, closer to 1.0 means closer to reference thromboplastin. The common therapeutic range is 2.0 to 3.0.
map.外文文献数值（mg/dL）换算为本地产报告（mmol/L）便于对比。: Convert foreign-literature values (mg/dL) to local reports (mmol/L) for comparison.
map.不同仪器单位（IU/L↔ng/mL）统一后做趋势跟踪。: Unify different-instrument units (IU/L ↔ ng/mL) for trend tracking.
map.教学与论文写作单位校对。: Unit proofreading for teaching and paper writing.
map.总胆固醇 200 mg/dL ÷ 38.67 ≈ 5.17 mmol/L，便于与: Total cholesterol 200 mg/dL ÷ 38.67 ≈ 5.17 mmol/L, for comparison with domestic report ranges.
map./定义不同，系数不同；工具按物质选系数，混用会错。: / definition differs, so the factor differs; the tool picks the factor by substance, and mixing them is wrong.
map.临床决策能用换算值吗？: Can clinical decisions use the converted value?
map.可以比对区间，但报告应以检测机构数值与单位为准，换算仅辅助。: You can compare ranges, but the report should use the testing lab's value and unit; conversion is only auxiliary.
map.对接近临界值的项目可能有影响，保留足够小数并标注单位。: It may affect near-cutoff items; keep enough decimals and label the unit.
map.约 39 类检验单位换算工具。跨报告与文献统一单位；纯换算，不涉及诊断。: About 39 classes of lab-unit conversion tools. Unify units across reports and literature; pure conversion, no diagnosis.
